svg.title: opentone test board block diagram
svg.desc: Block diagram of the opentone test board: an STM32F446 MCU connected to memory, two screens and the click-wheel input, driving a VS1053b codec that feeds the headphone jack, the Bluetooth module and a planned CS43131 DAC, with the power stage supplying each block through its named rails.
svg.text: USB-C · MCP73831 · LiPo → VSYS · MAX17048 gauge
